note: Attacker-controlled JP2 file is parsed box by box; the File Type box header (length=9, type='ftyp') is read from the input.
box.length=9 passes the size enforcement since it is within the remaining file size.
boxData is allocated with size 9-8=1 byte because the File Type box declares length 9 with only 1 byte of payload.
The 1-byte boxData vector is passed to isValidBoxFileType, triggering the vulnerable code path.
boxData.size()=1; subtracting 8u underflows the unsigned size_t to a huge value, so the modulo check passes incorrectly.
getULong reads 4 bytes from boxData.data() which points to a 1-byte buffer, causing an out-of-bounds read past the end of boxData.
